_comment: Shown in the update prompts. Edit before each release. minVersion: apps older than this must update before they continue (use for security fixes); leave it at an old version normally.
notes: EWUdiots Club has new royal-indigo colours, pastel tiles and solid icons, matching the design boards
Club Workspace: task board with a Review column, and task pages with files, labels, subtasks and comments
Register a club with a full application; the team reviews it with quick checks and can ask for changes
Roles & Permissions: permission matrix, role templates, presets and member access requests
Resources with folders, file previews and an in-app PDF viewer; recruitment, sponsors, elections and privacy redesigned
